note: Triennial election of the county council, 1949: nominations 17 May 1949; the only contest was Armagh City, polled 2 June 1949. The Armagh Guardian lists give no party labels, so none are given for the unopposed members. Returned unopposed. Twyble is a new member; M'Nabb is listed among the old members.
